title: Install parameters for enrolling users during a Private Access or ISP outage

prose.text: Two parameters let a fresh installation enroll new users while the Private Access cloud or the ISP is down, from a Business Continuity configuration downloaded in advance.

checks.do: Whether both the file path and the public key hash are passed, and whether the Client Connector version is new enough for the platform.

windows.statement: On Windows from Client Connector 4.6, bcpConfigFilePath (MSI `BCPCONFIGFILEPATH`) passes a predownloaded configuration file with Business Continuity settings, and bcpMAPublicKeyHash (MSI `BCPMAPUBKEYHASH`) passes the public key provided by Private Access for it, so Client Connector can enroll new users during a Private Access-related cloud outage or an ISP outage. Each requires the other.

quotes: Allows you to install Zscaler Client Connector to enroll new users during a Private Access-related cloud outage or Internet Service Provider (ISP) outage.
You can pass a predownloaded configuration file with Business Continuity settings from the Zscaler Admin Console.
you must also pass the BCPMAPUBKEYHASH or bcpMAPublicKeyHash option.
This option is available only in Zscaler Client Connector version 4.6 and later for Windows.
You can pass a public key provided by Private Access and copied from the Zscaler Admin Console.
you must also pass the BCPCONFIGFILEPATH or bcpConfigFilePath option.

macos.statement: macOS takes the same pair of keys, bcpConfigFilePath and bcpMAPublicKeyHash, each requiring the other, from Client Connector 4.7.0.64.

quotes: If you pass this install option, you must also pass the bcpMAPublicKeyHash option.
This option is available only in Zscaler Client Connector version 4.7.0.64 and later for macOS.
If you pass this install option, you must also pass the bcpConfigFilePath option.
